Verbatim copy of resources/SKSEMenuFramework.h from
https://github.com/QTR-Modding/SKSE-Menu-Framework-3 commit c97cdce (2026-09-03).
That repository is licensed GPL-3.0; the installed framework is 3.13.0.
The header resolves every function through GetProcAddress at runtime, so the
plugin has no link-time dependency and idles without the framework.

nlohmann/json.hpp is the single-header release v3.12.0 from
https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases/download/v3.12.0/json.hpp (MIT).
Vendored rather than fetched so the native test build (ctest --preset native)
needs no CMake configure step.
